newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down on low demand.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed down on Thursday amid low demand from borrowers and were seen opening steady after the Friday weekend, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were initially traded in the range of six percent and seven percent, one dealer said.
But the market slipped after most borrowers had squared their positions and the last deals were struck in the range of two percent and three percent, the dealer said.
Dealers said the market was likely to open at similar levels on Saturday.
